changes.description: Corrected an oracle false positive: an empty fragment is valid navigation to the document top. Named fragments still require an existing section. Original failed results are retained. The first affected run was fully rerun; later candidates use the identical correction.
Capture the visible text adjacent to each amount and manually verify the actual billing period for every landing. A global page-text match alone is not accepted as proof.

The oracle now recognizes newly appearing visible inline validation messages without demanding an undocumented notice selector. Static labels, user field values and hidden text do not establish error feedback.
Explicit equivalent local-device wording is recognized, and exact visible framing is manually reviewed for every app.
Recognize visible not-valid-JSON and could-not-complete error messages. Positive wording controls and negative silent-error controls passed; both apps receive the same A08 rerun.

limits: Automatic checks measure supplied contracts, not design quality.
Screenshot artifacts need independent visual review.
Unspecified confirmation/recovery control wording may require documented symmetric selector adjudication.
Counts are scenario coverage, not independent model trials.

additionalRegression.purpose: Visible inline error feedback, missing-feedback rejection, equivalent/absent local framing and silent quota failures.

projectNamedAll.diagnosticTrace: A document capture-phase listener records the actual requested project option before application handlers; this distinguishes a bad selector from an application resetting the selection. All four apps receive identical observation-only tracing.
